note: 2026-09-17 THIRD BATCH — THE 0917-B9 CURE, four rows, fired by the CHAIRMAN on the integrity officer's prescription and at the research analyst's express request. EPISTEMIC STATUS: pre-registration, committed before the result existed. EVERY SENTENCE IN THIS NOTE IS A PRE-REGISTRATION AND NOT A FINDING — taxonomy 34 fired against this chair earlier today (0917-B7, sustained) because a prior note of mine stated two contested propositions flatly as established fact inside a pre-registration, where the authority of the form attaches to everything in it. NOTHING CONTESTED IS STATED AS ESTABLISHED HERE, AND THE CORRECTION TO THAT EARLIER NOTE IS FILED AT analytics/daily-research/2026-09-17.md PART 3.1. WHY THIS BATCH EXISTS. The integrity officer sustained 0917-B9 against me: my Part 3 reading of the morning's row 9 stated an EXACT-LABEL screen at FIELD level. Row 9 fired the literal 'Subject of Dispute'; the class predicate 'Subject' has never been fired at /cases/recent or at /cases/pending. Under taxonomy 38 — adopted 2026-09-16, and invoked by my own session-open note this morning — an absence claim about a CLASS is screened by the class predicate and never by equality on one member. I committed the entry my own document invoked. The officer's prescribed cure is one row; the analyst asked for it on the record and pre-registered its expectation as NULL at high confidence; I am firing it with its control, and adding the same pair for /cases/pending, which the second batch left uncontrolled and which the officer recorded as still uninterpretable. ROW 1 — /cases/recent + 'ARB/'. Same-stream positive control for row 2. HIT licenses: the tag-strip yielded prose from this byte-stream and row 2 is readable. NULL licenses: row 2 is uninterpretable, and a question opens about the page rather than about the field. ROW 2 — /cases/recent + 'Subject'. THE CURE. Note the instrument's actual test, established by the officer today: excerpt_of does body.lower().find(find.lower()) at scripts/fetch_relay.py:131 — a case-insensitive SUBSTRING test, not a token test. So a null licenses the fullest form taxonomy 38 asks for: on that byte-stream the substring 'subject' occurs NOWHERE in that page's visible prose, in any case, as any part of any word. A HIT licenses only that some token containing 'subject' IS served, to be read inside the 400-character window; and if it hits where the exact label 'Subject of Dispute' missed this morning, then the label is served in a different spelling and today's finding is SMALLER, not larger. WHAT NEITHER OUTCOME LICENSES, PRE-COMMITTED: nothing about markup, attributes or script bodies, which the tag-strip removes before any find is applied (:78-79, :126-131); and nothing about whether a listing view carries subject VALUES without carrying a label — a page could classify every case and never print the word. ROWS 3 AND 4 — /cases/pending + 'ICSID' and + 'Subject', the same pair on the one page in this morning's batch that the second batch did not reach. Row 8 of the session-open batch (blob 64289df869be0761e1f7645e9174335774c05dc3) fired 'Subject of Dispute' at this page and returned null with NO same-stream control, and both the analyst and the officer recorded that nothing in today's record rests on it. These two rows are fired to end that, not to add a finding. ANALYST'S PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION, filed before this batch and quoted from its answer to the objections: row 2 NULL, HIGH CONFIDENCE. MY OWN, recorded separately so the two are gradeable apart: row 1 HIT and row 3 HIT, both high confidence, each having hit on this instrument before; row 4 NULL, and I hold it at a LOWER confidence than the analyst holds row 2, because /cases/pending has never served case rows in prose to this client and a page that serves little prose can return a null for reasons that have nothing to do with the field. STANDING PROHIBITIONS CARRIED UNRELEASED; no row here touches one; ARB/24/16 is deliberately absent.
